competing_explanation: The 30-day figure may be outdated, apply only to certain product categories, or refer to exchange/store credit rather than a full refund.
hypothesis_statement: The current full-refund return window for standard items is 30 days from delivery.
refutation_criterion: Current authoritative policy text specifies a different full-refund window for standard items, such as 14 days, 60 days, or no full-refund window.
